title: Specification Engineering Coverage Review
description: Coverage review for specification-engineering outputs. Veto invented business logic, redesign, or missing traceability.

criteria.description: Full traceability matrix (feature/business_rule/api/database/workflow/ADR/source) or explicit UNKNOWN
Required specification sections present or gapped
Missing information marked UNKNOWN rather than invented
No invented business logic or requirement changes; restates Product RE with pointers
Cross-references upstream packs without duplication sprawl; respects RACI ordering

veto_conditions.description: Invented business logic or changed requirements
Redesigns system beyond validated architecture inputs
